title: Grymm the Moorlord
description: POSTED: Grymm, the ancient blight-thing that rules the high moor's barrows, is too strong for any lone hunter — it has killed three who tried. The Highkeep bounty stands for a party that can bring it down and clear the moor's crown.
location_hint: The barrow-crown of the high moor, north-east of Highkeep.

objectives.desc: Slay Grymm the Moorlord with a party
